chain.title: A Housing for Gases
chain.desc: Craft from Quartz Glass, redstone dust and osmium ingots; it is the shell every ME chemical cell is built around and the whole bridge between AE2 storage and Mekanism chemistry.

chain.title: First Gas on the Network
chain.desc: Combine the chemical cell housing with an AE2 1k Storage Component; your ME network can now hold gases, slurries, infusion types and pigments as first-class stored types.

chain.title: Four Times the Vapour
chain.desc: Combine the housing with a 4k Storage Component; enough headroom to buffer the hydrogen and oxygen an Electrolytic Separator throws off.

chain.title: Sixteen Thousand
chain.desc: Combine the housing with a 16k Storage Component; the working tier for a full five-times ore processing chain with all its intermediate slurries.

chain.title: Acid by the Tank
chain.desc: Combine the housing with a 64k Storage Component; deep enough to stockpile sulfuric and hydrofluoric acid between production batches.

chain.title: Top of the Chemical Ladder
chain.desc: Combine the housing with a 256k Storage Component for the largest chemical cell the addon offers.

chain.title: Gas Down the Channel
chain.desc: Attune a plain ME P2P Tunnel with a Mekanism chemical item; it hauls gas across your network on the cable backbone instead of on a separate run of pressurized tubes.

chain.title: Gas in a Backpack
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from an ME Chest, a 1k Storage Component, an Energy Cell and a chemical cell housing; a self-powered chemical cell you can carry.

chain.title: The Field Tank
chain.desc: Craft the portable cell around a 256k Storage Component; carry a reactor's worth of gas out to a build site and back.

notes: The official Mekanism bridge for AE2. It adds no machines at all, only a new ME storage type, so the honest chain is one five-step tier ladder plus its portable mirror and the P2P tunnel - 9 steps, not padded to 20. ASSUMES FROM PARENT (ae2): Quartz Glass, cell_component_1k through 256k, ME Chest, Energy Cell, ME P2P Tunnel. ALSO ASSUMES MEKANISM: osmium ingots, and any chemical worth storing (hydrogen, oxygen, Ethylene, sulfuric acid, the ore slurry chain). VERIFICATION: strict model/lang intersection, 13/13 matched, no widening needed. DROPPED: appmek:creative_chemical_cell (creative-only, no recipe). appmek:chemical_p2p_tunnel is KEPT despite having no recipe file - AE2 P2P tunnels are obtained by attuning a base tunnel with an item listed in data/appmek/tags/items/p2p_attunements/chemical_p2p_tunnel.json, which is a normal survival action, not a creative grant.
